title: Bodycam: Mom Drove Drunk with 8-Year-Old Son in Car, Police Say
description:
Bodycam footage shows the moments surrounding the arrest of an Illinois mom after she allegedly drove drunk on November 24, 2023. Police at the University of Illinois Urbana-Campaign pulled Lindsey Green over after three people reported she was driving erratically. The 38-year-old mother had just dropped some of her kids off at school, while her 8-year-old was still in the car. Watch this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam to find out what happened next.

Subscribe to Law&Crime BodyCam: https://bit.ly/LawAndCrimeBodyCam  

Green said she was sober, but admitted to having two drinks after performing her sobriety test. After being taken into custody, Green voiced concern about her son's father taking care of him while she was locked up. The Illinois woman was charged with aggravated DUI, among other charges, and will appear in court to face these charges this year.
